learning_outcomes.text: Understands the differences between design for six sigma, lean six sigma, six sigma, and other quality planning and controls.
Choose the most appropriate tool/methods for statistical process control, process capability analysis, gauge capability analysis and lot sentencing, and justify the use of them.
Develop an effective product or service plan that use voice of customer and deploys it to quality characteristics and describe how quality can be controlled at product development stages.
Analyze data collected for stability, capability, mean, variability, robustness, make quality improvement decision based on the results, and verify the results.
Can effectively use statistical software such as MS Excel and Minitab to support the analysis of quality data and quality planning and control decisions.

syllabus_topics: Definitions of some basic quality control terms.
Objectives, methods, and scope of quality control.
Some principles and techniques of quality control.
Frequency distributions, X-R and X-S control charts.
Frequency distributions, X-R and X-S control charts.
Process capability. P and C control charts.
Organization and management of quality control.
bibliography: Chua,R.,DeFeo,"Juran's Quality Planning and Analysis", McGraw-Hill.
Douglas Montgomery,Statistical Quality Control,John Wiley & Sons, Inc
